# Parsify

> AI-powered bank statement converter for Indian Chartered Accountants, accountants, and finance teams. Converts PDF bank statements into Excel (XLSX), CSV, and Tally XML with 99.3% accuracy.

## Overview
Parsify automates the extraction and reconciliation of bank statements. It handles password-protected files, multi-page layouts, and scanned documents via specialized financial OCR, delivering clean, standardized rows formatted directly for Tally Prime, Zoho Books, and Excel.

## Key Facts
- **Supported Banks**: All major Indian banks (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, PNB, Bank of Baroda, Canara, Union Bank, IndusInd, Yes Bank, IDBI, Federal Bank, Indian Bank) plus leading banks in the USA, UK, UAE, Australia, and Singapore.
- **Accuracy**: 99.3% table and balance extraction accuracy.
- **Security**: Zero data retention. Files are processed in ephemeral memory and automatically purged.
- **Output Formats**: Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), CSV, and direct Tally Prime XML with auto-classified voucher types (Payment, Receipt, Contra) and GST tagging.

## Pricing
- Free: 1 statement/day without signup; 2 statements/day with a free account.
- Starter: ₹999/month (~40 statements / 500 pages)
- Growth: ₹1,999/month (~120 statements / 1,500 pages)
- Pro: ₹3,499/month (~400 statements / 5,000 pages)
